name: Tianxiang yu Xiaobaihe
source:
Tong Tinheung, a recent college graduate, was doing a job she wasn't interested in at a company she wasn't interested in. But as she decided to quit, she developed feelings for the Japanese manager of the supplier company, Matsuzaki Sayuri. So she decided to postpone her resignation plan and pour out her love to Sayuri in a fierce and direct way...
Tinheung & Sayuri is a short visual novel set in a corner of Shenzhen, China. A story that transcends the barriers of age, nationality, and gender.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088680/__Tinheung__Sayuri/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
刚毕业的童天香在一家自己不感兴趣的公司做着一份自己不感兴趣的工作。但当她决定辞职时，她对供应商公司的日本经理松崎小百合产生了感情。于是她决定推迟辞职计划，以激烈而直接的方式向小百合倾诉自己的爱……
《天兴与小百合》是一部以中国深圳一角为背景的视觉短篇小说。一个超越年龄、国籍和性别障碍的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088680/__Tinheung__Sayuri/]Steam[/url]]
